project.title: Asteroids
project.description: Classic-inspired Asteroids: rotate with LEFT/RIGHT, thrust with UP, fire with A. Rocks split in two.
project.author: PRG32 Kit

fields.TEXT: Asteroids: positions are in 1/16 pixel steps so the ship can drift smoothly.
Restart: score, lives, a new ship and the first wave; then show the title.
Big rocks start near the left or right edge with a random drift.
Mode 0 = title, 1 = playing, 2 = game over.
Big rocks start near the left or right edge with a random drift.
Playing: ship, bullets, rocks and collisions.
Rotate with LEFT and RIGHT: the angle is in degrees, 0 points up.
Thrust: sin and cos give the direction, 256 means 1.0.
Speed limit and friction, then move and wrap around the screen.
Fire: find a free bullet slot (up to 4 bullets).
Bullets fly for 36 frames and wrap around the screen.
Rocks drift and wrap; count how many are left.
Bullet hits: compare squared distances, no square root needed.

fields.COND: dx * dx + dy * dy <= radius * radius

fields.TEXT: Split: smaller rocks give more points, then the rock becomes one size smaller.
Find a free slot for the second half of the rock.
Ship collision: the ship counts as a circle of radius 4.
All rocks destroyed: a bigger wave starts.
Big rocks start near the left or right edge with a random drift.
Show the score in the PRG32 status band.
SCORE
Rocks are two circles; bullets are 2 x 2 squares (positions divided by 16).
The ship is a triangle of three lines, rotated with sin and cos; it blinks while safe.
